title: "IaC error codes"
tag: "Experimental"
description: Every stable error code an apply, plan or stack call can return, what it means and how to fix it. Generated from the code list.

<!-- Generated by scripts/geniacref from internal/iac/codes.go. Do not edit. -->

Codes are frozen: a released code is never renamed or reused, only added to. Match on the `code` field, not the message text.

| Code | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item_failed` | The item failed and no more specific code applies. | Read the message on the plan line; it names the resource and the cause. |
| `permission_denied` | The token may not read or write this resource. | Use a token with the needed ability, or remove the resource from the files. Other items are not affected. |
| `unavailable` | The control plane does not serve this kind of resource. | Check that the control plane runs a version that knows the kind. |
| `read_failed` | The live state of the resource could not be read, so it cannot be compared. | Retry. If it repeats, check the control plane logs. |
| `protected_resource` | The resource is protected from this change, for example a protected app that prune would delete. | Unprotect it, or declare it in the files. |
| `immutable_field` | A declared field cannot change in place, such as a database engine or version. | Recreate the resource deliberately, or set the field back to the live value. |
| `synced_externally` | The resource is owned by an outside source, such as a pipeline synced from a repository. | Change it at its source. |
| `ref_project_missing` | A resource names a project that does not exist and is not declared in the files. | Add a `Project` document or fix the name. |
| `ref_environment_missing` | A resource names an environment that does not exist in the project and is not declared in the files. | Add an `Environment` document or fix the name. |
| `ref_app_missing` | A resource names an app that does not exist and is not declared in the files. | Add the `App` document or fix the name. |
| `ref_secret_missing` | A `secretRef` marked `existing: true` points at a secret the app does not have. | Create the secret first, or drop `existing: true` and pass the value with `--secret`. |
| `schema_unknown_field` | A document has a field that is not part of its kind's schema. | Check the spelling against the [reference](/iac/reference), or remove the field. |
| `schema_version_unsupported` | The document `version` is not one this control plane reads. | Set `version: 1`. |
| `ownership_conflict` | The resource is already owned by a different stack or source. | Apply it from the stack or source that owns it, or release it there first. |
| `plan_stale` | The live state changed after the plan was made, so the plan no longer matches. | Run the plan again and apply the new one. |
| `plan_hash_version` | The submitted plan hash has the old unkeyed shape, which this control plane no longer accepts. | Run the plan again to get a current hash. |
| `stack_locked` | The resource belongs to a stack with drift policy `lock`, so manual changes are refused (HTTP 409). | Change the manifest and apply it, or ask an administrator. See [Drift](/stacks#drift). |
| `stack_source_sync` | The stack is synced from a source, so a direct apply is refused. | Change the source, not the stack. |
| `prune_guard` | Prune was refused because it would delete more of the stack than the prune guard allows without confirmation. | Check the plan, then confirm with `allow_mass_prune` if the deletions are intended. |
| `apply_disabled` | Apply is switched off for this control plane or stack. | Ask an administrator to enable it. |
| `invalid_request` | The request itself is malformed, for example a missing or unreadable field. | Fix the request and send it again. |
| `invalid_document` | A document failed validation. | Read the issue lines; each names the file, line and field. |
| `approval_pending` | A cloud plan would replace the saved engine plan of a revision awaiting approval. | Approve or reject the named revision first, or plan with supersede=true to retire it. |
| `plan_superseded` | A later plan replaced the saved engine plan this approval named. | Plan again and request a new approval. |
| `interrupted` | The control plane stopped while the plan job ran. | Plan again. |
| `plan_job_not_found` | No plan job with this id exists for the stack, or it was removed after the retention window. | Check the job id, or plan again. |
| `plan_timeout` | The plan job ran past cloud.engine_timeout_seconds. | Plan again, or raise cloud.engine_timeout_seconds. |
| `sync_repo_unreachable` | The git repository of a synced stack could not be fetched, or its credential could not be used. | Check the repo URL, branch and credential_ref, then run a sync refresh. |
| `sync_path_invalid` | The sync path leaves the checkout, points into .git, or holds a symlink. | Use a relative path with no .. and no symlinks. |
| `sync_limits_exceeded` | The repository or the files under the sync path passed a size or file count limit. | Trim the path, or raise stacks.sync_max_repo_mb, stacks.sync_max_files or stacks.sync_max_file_kb. |
| `sync_plan_failed` | The documents under the sync path did not validate or could not be planned. | Run the CLI plan on the same commit to see each issue. |
| `compose_path_invalid` | `spec.compose.path` is absolute, holds `..`, a backslash or a NUL byte, or points through a symlink. | Use a relative path inside the folder you apply, such as `compose/shop.yaml`. |
| `compose_ref_missing` | An App references a compose file that was not sent with the request. | Apply from the folder that holds the file with a current CLI, and check the path. |
| `compose_too_large` | A compose file, or all compose files together, is over the size cap. | Split the project or raise `iac.compose_max_file_kb` or `iac.compose_max_total_kb`. |
| `compose_too_many_files` | The request holds more compose files than the cap. | Apply fewer compose Apps at once or raise `iac.compose_max_files`. |
| `compose_mode_conflict` | An App sets both `spec.compose` and `spec.service`. | Keep one: `spec.compose` for a compose project, `spec.service` for a single service. |
| `compose_unsupported_key` | A referenced compose file uses a key strict mode refuses, such as `build`, `env_file`, `include`, `extends.file` or an unknown top level key. | Remove the key; put values in `spec.compose.env` and build images before you apply. |
| `compose_rejected` | A referenced compose file breaks a guard rule, such as `privileged`, host networking, a bind mount, a socket mount or a risky `extra_hosts` entry. The message names the rule. | Remove the setting the rule names; IaC compose Apps never get host access. |
| `compose_secret_literal` | A referenced compose file holds what looks like a literal secret. The message names the service and key, never the value. | Replace the value with `${NAME}` and declare `NAME` in `spec.compose.env` with a secretRef. |
| `compose_var_missing` | A `${VAR}` in a referenced compose file is not declared in `spec.compose.env`. The host environment is never read. | Declare the variable in `spec.compose.env`, or give it a default with `${VAR:-value}`. |
| `compose_no_deploy_unsupported` | `no_deploy` was asked for a plan that holds a compose App, and the compose endpoint deploys on every save. | Apply without `no_deploy`, or leave the compose App out of this apply. |
| `sync_secret_in_repo` | A synced document holds a literal secret value. The status names the file and line, never the value. | Replace the literal with a secretRef, set the value with the secrets API, then rotate the leaked credential. |
| `sync_disk_low` | Free disk was below stacks.sync_min_free_mb, so the sync fetched nothing. | Free disk on the control plane data volume or lower the setting. |
| `sync_apply_failed` | A sync apply was refused or failed and the stack was left unchanged. | Run the stack plan on the same commit; check the stack lock, protected apps and the apply setting. |
